sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Revisionist :- B.K.Tripathi
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by judgement and order dated 28.07.1998 passed by Sri C.N. Misra, Special Judge (Prevention of Corruption),
Gorakhpur in Criminal Appeal No. 74 of 1991, dismissing appeal and affirming conviction and sentence imposed by Sri D.K. Shukla, IIIrd Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gorakhpur vide judgement and order dated 17.08.1991, in Case No. 1371 of 1991 under Section 16(1)(a)(i) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.
Being aggrieved, revisionist preferred present revision.

3. Having gone through the record, I do not find any manifest error or otherwise illegality,
procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.
